findings.title: Relocating the active workspace re-lists the Library before the new folder's sync provider is detected
findings.body:
For the active workspace, `relocateWorkspace` goes through `relocateActive` (`relocate.ts:46-48`). On commit, that calls `afterCommit` (`switch-transaction.ts:136`), which runs `host?.broadcastLibraryChanged()` (`index.ts:524-530`). So the windows re-list the Library **before** `syncStates.refresh(current)` runs here at line 755.

Until the refresh settles, `syncStates.of(active)` sees a path that differs from the cached one and falls back to `syncProviderOfPath(entry.path)` (`sync-state.ts:26-30`). That check does no `realpath` and no xattr read. A folder that only `detectSync` recognises gets `null` from it: a Drive folder reached through a symlink, or Drive mounted somewhere else and caught only by `com.google.drivefs.item-id#S` (`synced-folder.ts:80-91`). In that case `activeEvictionProbe()` returns null, and `LibraryVault` is built without a probe (`library/index.ts:72-74`). Evicted files are then listed as local and get thumbnail URLs, and the "In the cloud: download it first" state never shows.

After the refresh, this handler only calls `broadcastState()` (line 759). Nothing triggers another Library re-list, so the wrong listing stays until something else refreshes it. Nothing tells the user.

The sibling handlers detect first: `addWorkspace` refreshes at line 578 before `runSwitch` at 601, and `createWorkspace` refreshes at 630 before 635. Two possible fixes:
- Detect the provider of `chosen` before the transaction commits.
- Call `host?.broadcastLibraryChanged()` after the refresh when the relocated workspace is the active one.

I marked this medium confidence because it depends on the renderer's list request arriving before `realpath` plus the `/usr/bin/xattr` exec finish, and I did not measure that.

contracts.equivalent_path: addWorkspace (index.ts:578, 601-611) and createWorkspace (index.ts:630-646): syncStates.refresh, then availabilityOf, then runSwitch/broadcastState, then toWorkspaceView with syncStates.of
contracts.before_after: The siblings refresh sync state before the switch transaction re-lists the windows. Relocate refreshes after relocateActive has already committed, and afterCommit has already called broadcastLibraryChanged. After the refresh it only calls broadcastState, so it does not re-list the Library. The refresh does come before availabilityOf, so the probe is bounded correctly for a synced folder.
contracts.visible_effect: The returned workspace view carries the detected provider (Settings row, dialog). broadcastState updates the switcher. The Library listing of an active relocated workspace may have been built with the path-rule answer.
contracts.failure_mode: detectSync never throws: every step goes through withTimeout with a fallback, so an unanswered step reads as 'no provider'. availabilityOf is bounded at 5 s plus a 1 s stat. A rejection elsewhere after relocateWorkspace has committed would skip refreshTitles and broadcastState, but no such rejection path was found in these calls.

structuredOutput.summary: The new `relocateFolder` lines detect the relocated folder's sync provider before the bounded availability probe and return a `workspace` view, as `WorkspaceRelocateResult` requires. One ordering problem: when the active workspace is relocated, `afterCommit` re-lists the Library before `syncStates.refresh` runs, and nothing re-lists it afterwards. A synced folder that only `realpath` or the Drive xattr can identify can therefore be listed without the eviction probe. The two earlier threads (migration journal and snapshot) are on files outside this part, so they get no replies here.

findings.title: Relocating the active workspace re-lists the Library before the new folder's sync provider is detected
findings.body:
For the active workspace, `relocateWorkspace` goes through `relocateActive` (`relocate.ts:46-48`). On commit, that calls `afterCommit` (`switch-transaction.ts:136`), which runs `host?.broadcastLibraryChanged()` (`index.ts:524-530`). So the windows re-list the Library **before** `syncStates.refresh(current)` runs here at line 755.

Until the refresh settles, `syncStates.of(active)` sees a path that differs from the cached one and falls back to `syncProviderOfPath(entry.path)` (`sync-state.ts:26-30`). That check does no `realpath` and no xattr read. A folder that only `detectSync` recognises gets `null` from it: a Drive folder reached through a symlink, or Drive mounted somewhere else and caught only by `com.google.drivefs.item-id#S` (`synced-folder.ts:80-91`). In that case `activeEvictionProbe()` returns null, and `LibraryVault` is built without a probe (`library/index.ts:72-74`). Evicted files are then listed as local and get thumbnail URLs, and the "In the cloud: download it first" state never shows.

After the refresh, this handler only calls `broadcastState()` (line 759). Nothing triggers another Library re-list, so the wrong listing stays until something else refreshes it. Nothing tells the user.

The sibling handlers detect first: `addWorkspace` refreshes at line 578 before `runSwitch` at 601, and `createWorkspace` refreshes at 630 before 635. Two possible fixes:
- Detect the provider of `chosen` before the transaction commits.
- Call `host?.broadcastLibraryChanged()` after the refresh when the relocated workspace is the active one.

I marked this medium confidence because it depends on the renderer's list request arriving before `realpath` plus the `/usr/bin/xattr` exec finish, and I did not measure that.
